Build a sunlit factory workshop presented as a roofless cutaway, with a rectangular concrete floor, concrete walls along the rear and both sides, and an open front facing a loading yard. Arrange two parallel conveyor assembly lines inside the workshop, separated by a broad central aisle that continues into the yard. Place industrial robotic arms beside the conveyors and control desks at the ends of the lines. Along the rear wall, group a boiler, a powder-storage unit, electrical cabinets, and connected metal pipes into a compact utility zone. Set a raised metal platform with railings and an access stair beside this equipment. Keep a storage area along one side wall, with tall shelving, grouped boxes, pallets, and clustered barrels. Put a forklift near the shelving and a pallet cart near the open front. Use concrete pillars to divide the workshop into bays, and place industrial lamps and signs near the work areas. Add short fence sections along the edges of the loading yard while leaving its entrance open. Give the concrete and metal surfaces a worn industrial appearance. Keep the two production lines, rear utility zone, side storage, and open circulation routes clearly distinguishable under daylight.
